description: Source code for the mantissoapInterface class, which integrates with a Mantis Bug Tracker SOAP API to perform issue tracking operations such as retrieving, creating, and adding notes to issues. The class extends issueTrackerInterface and includes functions for connecting via SOAP, checking bug existence, getting issue details, and managing configuration.

classes.name: mantissoapInterface
classes.description: A class to interface with Mantis Bug Tracker via SOAP API, allowing connection management, bug retrieval, creation, and note addition.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Generates a URL to view a specific bug using its ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a SOAP connection to the bug tracking system.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a SOAP client object based on configuration.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with a specific ID exists on the bug tracker.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue identified by ID.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the SOAP connection is currently established.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with specified summary and description, returning status, ID, and messages.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note to an existing issue, with options for reporter and note text.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if the current configuration allows issue creation via API.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Returns a formatted HTML string representing the issue status with color coding.

methods.name: setStatusCfg
methods.description: Sets the status color configuration from user-defined settings.

methods.name: getCodeStatus
methods.description: Returns the code status for issues.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Retrieves the current status color mapping.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks if the PHP environment has the necessary SOAP extension enabled.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a bug ID.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Generates an HTML string for issue status with optional decoration.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration snippet for the class.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration with default URLs if missing.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Sets resolved status configuration (not explicitly shown in provided code but mentioned).
